name: Atesmerta, Atesmerius

attributes.attribute: Continental Celtic goddess attested from Gaulish inscriptions
Continental Celtic god attested from Gaulish inscriptions

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Atesmerta and Atesmerius are a Continental Celtic goddess and god. Deities of these names appear in several inscriptions from Gaul. Nothing more than their names is known about them.
objective: Establish Atesmerta and Atesmerius as Continental Celtic deities known only from Gaulish inscriptions.
key_results: Both deities are attested from inscriptions in Gaul.
Both are known only through their names.
